messages:
zach: quick postmortem follow-up  tiny-request tail kept jumping after adapter refactor, captured options here.
olivia: observed same. root cause: cohort hints dropped by proxy so many 1-2 token reqs hit main coalesce path.
maria: options: 1) opaque admission hint (size_enum + deadline) 2) context-metadata hack 3) runtime heuristics. prefer (1) for clarity.
kevin: enforcement: min viable = per-tenant decaying credits + fallback to normal lane when exhausted. decays to avoid cliffy replenishes.
olivia: also need global circuit-breaker: if tiny_fallback_rate > threshold, widen coalesce windows or throttle tiny lane.
maria: telemetry reqs: micro_lane_enq, micro_lane_reject_credit, micro_lane_p95, coalesce_fill_ratio, tenant_credit_level. Ops needs dashboards pre-canary.
zach: rollout: feature-flag hint API -> credit logic behind flag -> expose metrics -> small canary -> tune decay/credits.
kevin: future: virtual coalescing in scheduler to reduce kernel startup work. mark as medium effort.
dev-bot: CI green for branch=feature/tiny-hint-credit at 3532109922 :white_check_mark:
maria: decision: implement minimal hint + decaying credits + telemetry + global escape hatch. owners: @olivia runtime, @aj API, @maria telemetry. will open follow-up RFC. :thumbsup:
